Visitor replaces input with labeled output

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitInput(NodeContext ctx, String inputType, String name, String value) {        return new VisitResult.Custom(String.format("[INPUT:%s]", inputType));    }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<form><label>Username: <input type=\"text\" name=\"username\" value=\"\"></label><label>Password: <input type=\"password\" name=\"password\"></label></form>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
